title: Motifs
description: Optional fitting choice. A theme for the whole vessel that grants equipment and alterations useful for common activities.

options.name: Transport
options.description: A vessel themed around moving passengers, with built-in passenger quarters and a sturdy panic room.
options.special: Identified at a glance as a passenger vessel.

options.name: Hauling
options.description: A cargo-moving vessel with gangplanks, winches, bay doors, and a reliable cargo crane.
options.special: Identified at a glance as a cargo hauler.

options.name: Hunting
options.description: A vessel kitted for the oldest wildsea profession, with trophies, animal pens, and hunting and butchery tools.
options.special: Crew fighting on or below decks gain easy access to CQ Keen or Spike damage.

options.name: Salvaging
options.description: A vessel for scrappers, dredgers, and wreck-wranglers, with work benches, tools, and a grappling crane.
options.special: Can haul large wreckage onto the deck or tow it behind the ship.

options.name: Pathfinding
options.description: Built for tenacious exploration, with a reinforced engine room and wilds-clearing tools.
options.special: Crew fighting on or below decks gain easy access to Hewing or Serrated damage.

options.name: Raiding
options.description: A vessel taking to the waves with violence in mind, with fortified rails, lockable bulkheads, and an armoury lockbox.
options.special: Crew fighting on or below decks gain easy access to Blunt or Blast damage.

options.name: Rescue
options.description: A vessel called on when other ships do not make it back, with emergency medicine, a photoscope, and an isolation room.
options.special: Slows the progress of illnesses during a journey.

options.name: Research
options.description: A vessel for cracking the mysteries of the sea, with a library and a deck-mounted snapograph.
options.special: Can record findings and delve into secrets and lore.

options.name: Entertainment
options.description: A vessel for actors, musicians, and performers, with a gaudy appearance, a stage, and costuming supplies.
options.special: Crew can represent various creeds and characters with costuming.
